content: Description of Data Exchange Point Shall Describe Relevant Spec Items 41 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall support description of spec items from all template specifications that are relevant for the data exchange point. Rationale: Some Spec Items have the character of a checkable constraint. Or the selection of spec items document supported AUTOSAR capabilities. Reduce risk of interoperability issues that are cause by • different interpretation or selection of spec items • not having implemented required AUTOSAR functionality Use Case: [UC_STDT_00020] Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
